name: radio
title: Radio
summary: Single-select group built on Radix RadioGroup. .lumen-radio shell; inner dot composed via CSS ::after on data-state=checked. Items render as RadioGroupItem inside a RadioGroup. Grid layout with gap-3 by default.
description: Token-driven single-select radio group with .lumen-radio shell.
skillDescription: Use for single-select choices — payment method, shipping option, role. For 2-3 options consider Segmented instead. For 4+ in a tight space use Select.
useWhen: Single-select choices (payment method, role, shipping option).
anatomy: Inner dot (CSS ::after, animated in on checked)
never: NEVER use Radio for 2 options — use Switch or Segmented.
NEVER use Radio outside a RadioGroup — single Radio doesn't make sense.
NEVER mix Radio styles within a single group.
a11yRules: Radix manages role=radiogroup / role=radio, arrow-key navigation, focus management.
Pair each item with a <Label htmlFor>.
Group has aria-labelledby for the group label.
do: Pair each option with a Label.
